description: A TIMING probe, not a modelling run: phys_timing2_evt_25pct plus eventsManager.synchronizeOnSimSteps = false, decoupling the qsim from the events pipeline so the iteration wall approaches the slower of the two instead of their per-simstep maximum. Model outputs unchanged (handlers see the complete stream); the price is buffered-event memory - watch the working set - and eventually-consistent live telemetry snapshots. NOTHING PRODUCED UNDER THIS OVERLAY IS A RESULT.

justification.RUN.controler.last_iteration: The declared sweep starts at 250 because that is the largest value MEASURED to be insufficient for convergence (DECISIONS.md 9.7, 9.43), so the range describes candidate MODELLING runs. This is a wall-clock measurement priced before the converged arm's relaunch. The value is deliberately far below the declared range so any output carrying it is obviously not a result.
